extractionRules.unit: one non-empty fixed string fragment, including whitespace-only geometry, from one explicitly contracted presentation sink or reachable typed string-producer return; runtime slots and Cartesian condition combinations are not fixed source strings
extractionRules.composition: template, binary concatenation, same-function string =/+= flow, conditional alternatives, trim, typed render-array push, recursively discovered typed producer returns, module constants, nested styles, and key hints

channels.printable-visible: text whose contract reaches a user-visible terminal, stdout, or stderr presentation sink
channels.terminal-protocol: terminal control traffic; inventoried separately and not claimed as printable screen content

extractionRules.instrumentation: per-file fixed-fragment obligations retain the original application value, register pending provenance out of band when that exact fragment is present, and add paired OSC 777 begin/end spans only at stdout/stderr emission when RENDER_DIFF_VISIBLE_SITES=1; printable coverage requires a terminal cell or geometry effect inside the span
extractionRules.soundnessBoundary: closed over declared explicit sink contracts, same-function flow, module constants, and recursively discovered in-root producers with explicit string/string[] return contracts; dynamic slots are not source strings, while any in-root producer without a contract is unresolved dataflow and fails validation; external and dynamically dispatched producers remain opaque runtime values
